cohort: 204 antenatal women between 6 and 28 weeks of pregnancy, 82 exposed to SHS and 122 not exposed.
finding: Pregnant women exposed to secondhand smoke had reduced pulmonary function (lower FEV1 and FEV6) and a higher incidence of preterm birth and small for gestational age babies.
